data.name: About_Licence
data.value: DispHub is open source under the GNU General Public License v3.0. It stores everything on your PC and sends no telemetry.

data.name: About_Note1
data.value: Hi, I'm Quinten. I built DispHub because I kept opening three different control panels just to make a game look right or to make my screen easier on the eyes at night. I wanted one small, quiet app that does it properly and looks like it belongs on Windows.

data.name: About_Note2
data.value: DispHub is made by one person, in spare time, with a lot of care. If it makes your screen a little nicer to look at, that means a lot. Ideas and bug reports are always welcome on GitHub; I read every one.

data.name: About_NoteSignature
data.value: Thank you for using DispHub. — Quinten (qlintenFX)

data.name: Upgrade_Body
data.value:
{0} is part of DispHub Pro.
Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks: • Every screen effect look, and saving your own • Per-app profiles that switch automatically • Schedules with smooth fades • Different settings per display • More than {1} profiles
It also supports development of DispHub.

data.name: Onboarding_WelcomeText
data.value: DispHub keeps display profiles: brighter shadows and richer colours for games, warmer and dimmer for the evening, or your screen's own colours. Switch with one click or a hotkey, or let DispHub switch for you per app or by the time of day. Here's how to find everything.

data.name: Onboarding_TrayTitle
data.value: DispHub lives next to the clock

data.name: Onboarding_TrayText
data.value: Its icon sits in the notification area at the right of the taskbar. If you don't see it, it's under the ^ arrow; you can drag it out to keep it in view.

data.name: Onboarding_LeftClickHint
data.value: Choose what it opens. You can change this later in Settings.

data.name: Onboarding_RightClickHint
data.value: The menu: your profiles, turn DispHub off or on, open the window and exit.

data.name: Onboarding_HotkeysText
data.value: These keyboard shortcuts work in any app, even in full-screen games. A small message shows which profile is on. Change them in Settings.

data.name: Onboarding_PowerTitle
data.value: One button turns it all off

data.name: Onboarding_PowerText
data.value: The power button at the top of DispHub's menu, and in the quick panel, turns DispHub off: your displays show their original colours and screen effects stop. Press it again to carry on where you were.

data.name: Effects_OffText
data.value: Screen effects come back when DispHub is turned on with the power button.

data.name: Schedule_StatusDispHubOff
data.value: DispHub is off, so the schedule waits. Turn it on with the power button.

data.name: Effects_GamesHint
data.value: Keep smooth: the game runs at its own frame rate and only grain, scanlines, vignette, dust and fades go on top. Colour changes come from your profile there.
